policies.name: Single-Use Plastics Prohibition Regulations
policies.summary: Bans the manufacture, import, and sale of six single-use plastic items: checkout bags, cutlery, foodservice ware made from problematic plastics, ring carriers, stir sticks, and straws.

newsFeed.headline: Canada's plastic ban survives industry court challenge on appeal
newsFeed.summary: A federal appeal court upheld Canada's authority to regulate single-use plastics as a toxic substance, clearing the way for ongoing enforcement.

wooby.headline: Canada banned 6 kinds of single-use plastic — and won in court.
wooby.narrative: Wooby visits Canada's long Pacific and Atlantic coasts. In 2022 Canada banned plastic straws, cutlery, bags, and rings — yes, the rings that hold soda cans together that hurt animals. Some companies took Canada to court, but Canada won. Wooby is proud.
